summary: Join our specialized training course on Procurement Management in the Oil and Gas industry. Learn best practices to streamline processes and maximize value!
lede: Procurement Management in the Oil and Gas Industry equips professionals to move beyond reactive buying and create measurable strategic value across complex, capital-intensive projects. You will build practical capabilities in market analysis, sourcing strategy, supplier evaluation, contract structuring, category optimization, compliance management, and supplier relationship management. The course addresses real operating pressures, including volatile markets, engineering changes, remote logistics, specialized requirements, limited supplier pools, and the need to balance cost reduction with risk mitigation. You will learn to assess supplier resilience, identify concentrated procurement risks, set realistic cost reduction targets, optimize total cost of ownership, and maintain technical, safety, regulatory, and operational integrity.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who are directly responsible for, or accountable for, procurement performance and supplier management across oil and gas organizations.
audience: Category Specialists focused on specific procurement areas
modules: Foundations of Oil and Gas Procurement Strategy
Procurement Strategy Integration and Performance Management
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 2-3 years of procurement, supply chain, or vendor management experience, preferably in industrial, manufacturing, or project-based environments. Basic understanding of contract terms and supplier evaluation concepts is beneficial. Familiarity with oil and gas operations terminology is helpful but not required.
